en.text: Introducing **LoongForge-VLDA**, a Vision-Language-Delta-Action model trained with LoongForge: 98.5% on LIBERO, 84.5% zero-shot on LIBERO-Plus, and +17–18 points over π0.5 on real robots.

zh.text: 推出 **LoongForge-VLDA**：基于 LoongForge 训练的 Vision-Language-Delta-Action 模型，LIBERO 98.5%，LIBERO-Plus 零样本 84.5%，真机领先 π0.5 17–18 个点。

en.text: Added training support for **GLM-5.3-flash**.

zh.text: 新增 **GLM-5.3-flash** 训练支持。

en.text: Added **Kimi-K3** BF16 training support for both LLMs and VLMs.

zh.text: 新增 **Kimi-K3** BF16 训练支持，覆盖 LLM 与 VLM。

en.text: Added an optimized **DreamZero Wan2.2-5B FSDP recipe** with cache-aware data loading, compiled attention blocks, frozen-module handling, and FSDP2 Delta-FP8 Param AllGather.

zh.text: 新增优化版 **DreamZero Wan2.2-5B FSDP 训练方案**：缓存感知的数据加载、编译加速的 attention 块、冻结模块处理，以及 FSDP2 Delta-FP8 参数 AllGather。

en.text: Added VLA training support for **Wall-OSS-0.5**, with custom fused operators for higher training throughput.

zh.text: 新增 **Wall-OSS-0.5** VLA 训练支持，并通过自定义融合算子进一步提升训练吞吐。

en.text: Released the **TAOT paper** — topology-aware dynamic expert replica placement that tackles EP load imbalance in MoE training, cutting overhead by up to **74%** over industry solutions, with **1.43× speedup** on a real training case.

zh.text: 发布 **TAOT 论文**：拓扑感知的动态专家副本放置，解决 MoE 训练中的 EP 负载不均衡，开销较业界方案最高降低 **74%**，在真实训练案例中实测 **1.43× 加速**。

en.text: Added training support for **GLM-5.2**, plus a **GLM-5.2 + MoonViT** custom-composition example that extends GLM with multimodal capabilities.

zh.text: 新增 **GLM-5.2** 训练支持，并提供 **GLM-5.2 + MoonViT** 自由组合示例，为 GLM 扩展多模态能力。

en.text: Added training support for **MiniCPM-V-4.6** and **Qwen3.8-27B**.

zh.text: 新增 **MiniCPM-V-4.6** 与 **Qwen3.8-27B** 训练支持。

en.text: Introduced a unified **evaluation module** for the embodied stack, currently covering Pi0.5 / xVLA / GR00T, with more models on the way.

zh.text: 具身训练栈新增统一的**评测模块**，目前覆盖 Pi0.5 / xVLA / GR00T，更多模型陆续接入。

en.text: Unified the **prebuilt Docker images** — all model families (LLM / VLM / VLA / Diffusion) now share a single image.

zh.text: 统一**预构建 Docker 镜像**：LLM / VLM / VLA / Diffusion 全部模型家族共用同一个镜像。

en.text: Released **LoongForge-Embodied**, a torch-native DDP/FSDP training subsystem for embodied models (Pi0.5, GR00T-N1.6/N1.7, xVLA, LingBot-VA, FastWAM, DreamZero, and Cosmos3), with up to **4.38× speedup**.

zh.text: 发布 **LoongForge-Embodied**：面向具身模型的 torch-native DDP/FSDP 训练子系统，覆盖 Pi0.5、GR00T-N1.6/N1.7、xVLA、LingBot-VA、FastWAM、DreamZero 与 Cosmos3，最高 **4.38× 加速**。

en.text: Added training support for **DeepSeek-V4-Flash / DeepSeek-V4-Pro**.

zh.text: 新增 **DeepSeek-V4-Flash / DeepSeek-V4-Pro** 训练支持。

en.text: Added training support for **Qwen-Image-Edit-2511**.

zh.text: 新增 **Qwen-Image-Edit-2511** 训练支持。

en.text: Expanded VLA coverage with **GR00T N1.6**; **2.3× speedup** on GR00T training.

zh.text: VLA 覆盖扩展至 **GR00T N1.6**，GR00T 训练 **2.3× 加速**。

en.text: Accelerated **Wan 2.2** training by **116%**, and added CP and data packing support.

zh.text: **Wan 2.2** 训练加速 **116%**，并新增 CP 与数据 packing 支持。

en.text: Added training support for **Kimi K2.5 / K2.6**, and introduced **INT4 / NVFP4** PTQ.

zh.text: 新增 **Kimi K2.5 / K2.6** 训练支持，并引入 **INT4 / NVFP4** PTQ。

en.text: **v0.1.0** — the first official tagged release of LoongForge.

zh.text: **v0.1.0** —— LoongForge 首个正式发布版本。

en.text: Powered the training and public release of **LLaVA-OneVision-2.0**.

zh.text: 支撑 **LLaVA-OneVision-2.0** 的训练与公开发布。

en.text: Added training support for **MiniMax-M2.7** on both NVIDIA GPU and Kunlun XPU.

zh.text: 新增 **MiniMax-M2.7** 训练支持，覆盖 NVIDIA GPU 与昆仑芯 XPU。

en.text: LoongForge source code is publicly available on GitHub.

zh.text: LoongForge 源码在 GitHub 正式开源。

en.text: Powered the training and public release of **LLaVA-OneVision-1.5** under AIAK-Training-LLM, the predecessor of LoongForge.

zh.text: 在 LoongForge 的前身 AIAK-Training-LLM 上，支撑 **LLaVA-OneVision-1.5** 的训练与公开发布。
